caption: The drawing depicts a three-legged metal object, likely an andiron, rendered primarily in shades of black and gray pencil on an off-white background. The main object is centrally positioned, shown in three-quarters perspective, which highlights its circular loop at the top, a thick vertical body, and two curved front legs with squared ends, as well as a horizontal extension at the back. In the upper left corner, there is a front view outline of the object, including a scale labeled "INCHES" with numerical increments below it. In the upper right corner, a side view outline shows the object's profile and the circular top. The drawing is enclosed in a fine, rectangular border, and the artist's signature, "Mildred Ford," appears in the lower right corner. The background of the paper remains unshaded, keeping attention on the tones and textures of the depicted object.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
